summary: Improve hotel resource controls, food-waste planning and sustainability reporting. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Environmental sustainability in hospitality helps hotel teams assess impacts and manage resources across guest services and back-of-house operations. For operations managers, sustainability coordinators and facilities leads, the training covers mapping impacts, interpreting utility and occupancy records, and setting energy, water and food-waste controls; learners also screen suppliers and build scorecards and action plans for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence hotel environmental performance through daily operations, resource controls, purchasing or guest-service decisions.
prerequisites: Working exposure to hotel, resort or hospitality operations and routine environmental or resource records is recommended. No programming is required.
